concept.hook: Your AI startup isn't a wrapper problem. It's a taste problem.
concept.angle: Distribution and taste are the real moats, not the model.
concept.script: Everyone says you're just a GPT wrapper. Cool - so was every SaaS a 'database wrapper.' The moat was never the model. It's taste, distribution, and the thousand product decisions nobody screenshots. Here's how to tell if yours is real...
concept.visual_prompt: A clean, modern talking-head explainer for ai-founders. Visual style: minimal, high-contrast, on-screen captions. Scene reflects: distribution and taste as moats.

score.judge_rationale: Strong contrarian hook with clear trend fit and good clarity; novelty is moderate. Low cringe and policy risk. Baseline generation, so the win probability is anchored at 0.5.

harness_diff.script_prompt_change: Add an explicit instruction to name the consensus view before subverting it.
harness_diff.rationale: The contrarian hook scored highest on hook_strength and trend_fit; reinforce it and suppress generic listicles.

lesson.observation: The contrarian hook outscored generic framings on hook_strength and trend_fit for the AI-founder audience.
lesson.rule: For founder-facing AI content, prefer contrarian or diagnostic hooks over generic listicles.
lesson.evidence: Generation 1: contrarian_hook concept scored 0.82 hook_strength and 0.78 trend_fit, weighted_total 0.71.
lesson.harness_change: Increase contrarian_hook weight (+0.1) and decrease generic_listicle (-0.1); reinforce in script_prompt.
lesson.expected_effect: Later generations open with sharper, consensus-subverting hooks and avoid generic listicles, lifting the predicted win probability.
